import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

api = RestAPI({"users": []})
for name in ["Adam", "Bob"]:
    api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": name}))

# Repeated same-direction IOUs accumulate, with float precision
for amt in [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]:
    resp = json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": amt})))
print("accumulated:", resp["users"][1]["owes"], resp["users"][0]["balance"])

# Full repayment returns to a clean zero state
resp = json.loads(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 0.6})))
print("repaid:", resp)

# Balance always equals owed_by minus owes for every user
for u in json.loads(api.get("/users"))["users"]:
    assert round(sum(u["owed_by"].values()) - sum(u["owes"].values()), 2) == u["balance"], u
print("balance invariant OK")
EOF
